en: Multi‑view vintage postcard showing scenes of Kronstadt (today Brașov): the large Evangelical church (the Black Church), a bustling market in the main square with the Council House and the street labeled Klostergasse, a vignette of the Schützenhaus, and the Reformed Church. Caption in German reads "Gruss aus Kronstadt." The reverse is a Hungarian "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP" with Austrian postmarks and an 1898 date, addressed to Vienna.
